verdict.rationale: Warp's session restoration docs say it automatically restores windows, tabs, panes, and recent Blocks when you relaunch, so you can pick up where you left off in your previous session (warp-docs-21, warp-docs-35). The docs also cover keeping sensitive Blocks from being saved (warp-docs-36). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that working directories are restored, explicit coverage of crash recovery as opposed to normal relaunch, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
